newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Fujian to invest $24 bln in port.
newsitem.headline: China's Fujian to invest $24 bln in port.

text.p: Chinese authorities have decided to invest 200 billion yuan ($24.1 billion) to turn Meizhou Bay in the southeastern province of Fujian into a major port, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Xinhua did not say how the money would be raised.
Construction of the port was scheduled to be completed in the year 2005, Xinhua said.
It would have annual cargo handling capacity of 100 million tonnes, it said.
Meizhou Bay covers an area of 643 square km, with a population of 790,000.
The port city would be divided into two parts, with the north focusing on chemicals, processing and the tourism industry and the south concentrating on petrochemicals, Xinhua said.
Several projects, including docks, railway, espressway and a water works, have either been completed or construction is under way, it said.
Provincial authorities have approved the establishment of 96 foreign-funded projects in Meizhou Bay involving investment of 13 billion yuan.
